```{r setup}
if (requireNamespace("correlation", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ci_cor <- correlation::ci_cor
} else {
  ci_cor <- function(x, y, method = "spearman", type = "bootstrap",
                     R = 10000, seed = NULL, boot_type = "bca",
                     conf.level = 0.95) {
    if (!is.null(seed)) {
      set.seed(seed)
    }

    keep <- complete.cases(x, y)
    x <- x[keep]
    y <- y[keep]
    estimate <- suppressWarnings(cor(x, y, method = method))
    boot_estimates <- replicate(
      R,
      {
        boot_index <- sample.int(length(x), replace = TRUE)
        suppressWarnings(cor(x[boot_index], y[boot_index], method = method))
      }
    )
    alpha <- 1 - conf.level
    ci <- quantile(
      boot_estimates,
      probs = c(alpha / 2, 1 - alpha / 2),
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    )

    data.frame(
      method = method,
      estimate = estimate,
      conf.low = ci[1],
      conf.high = ci[2],
      ci_method = paste(type, boot_type, sep = "_")
    )
  }
}
```

# Data Preparation

```{r load-data}
# Load data
questionnaires <- read.csv("data_baseline_questionnaires.csv")
endpoints <- read.csv("endpoints.csv")
tail(questionnaires$csid)
q_01 <- questionnaires[,c(1,2,3,4,10,11,15,16,18,19,21,22,23,24,28,29,34,
                          39,40,44,59,74,78,
                          81,82,83,      ###Passive smoking
                          128,129,137,220:223,
                          121,188,189,190,191,
                          205,209,213,218,  ###family  cancer
                          229,231:235,277,282,283)]
e_01 <- endpoints[,c(1,66:73)]
total1 <- left_join(q_01,e_01,by="csid")

# Exclude the participants with missing data in occupation
total1 <- total1 %>%
  subset(occupation != 9) %>%
  subset(!is.na(bmi_calc)) # exclude missing data in BMI

total2 <- total1 %>%
  mutate(age_at_study=age_at_study_date_x100/100,.keep=c("unused"),.after=age_at_study_date_x100) %>%
  rename(BMI="bmi_calc")%>%
  mutate(BMI.cat=ifelse(BMI<18.5, "underweight", ifelse(BMI<24, "normal", ifelse(BMI<28, "overweight", ifelse(BMI>=28, "obesity", NA)))),.after = BMI)%>%
  mutate(fam.ca=ifelse(mother_cancer %in% c(1)|father_cancer %in% c(1)|children_cancer %in% c(1),1,0),.after=children_cancer)%>%
  mutate(alcohol.cat=ifelse(alcohol_category %in% c(1,2),0,ifelse(alcohol_category %in% c(3,4),1,2)),.after = "alcohol_category") %>%
  #0 Never or previous 1 Occasion 2 Current
  mutate(smoking_category=ifelse(smoking_category %in% c(1),0,ifelse(smoking_category %in% c(3),1,2))) %>%
  #0 Never 1 previous 2 current
  mutate(marital_status =ifelse(marital_status %in% c(0),0,1)) %>%
  #0 Married
  mutate(education=ifelse(highest_education %in% c(0,1),0,ifelse(highest_education %in% c(2,3),1,2))) %>%
  mutate(occupation = ifelse(occupation %in% c(8),0,
                             ifelse(occupation %in% c(2,3,4,7),2,1))) %>%
  mutate(tc.case=ifelse(ep_range_C73_to__oinc_ep==1,1,0),
         tc.date=as.Date(ep_range_C73_to__oinc_datedeveloped),
         tc.death=as.Date(ep_range_C73_to__odu_datedeveloped),
         censor.date=as.Date(open_access_censoring_date),
         develop.date=pmin(as.Date(ep_range_C73_to__oinc_datedeveloped),as.Date(ep_range_C73_to__odu_datedeveloped)),
         fin.date=pmin(tc.date,censor.date,develop.date),
         fu.pre=time_length(difftime(tc.date,study_date),"years"),
         fu=time_length(difftime(fin.date,study_date), "years"),
         fu.death=time_length(difftime(tc.death,study_date),"years")) %>%
  mutate(household_income=ifelse(household_income %in% c(0,1,2),0,
                                 ifelse(household_income %in% c(3),1,2)))

total3 <- total2[,c("csid","age_at_study","is_female","education",
                  "occupation","marital_status","household_income","has_health_cover",
                  "smoking_category", "cancer_diag", "fam.ca", "BMI.cat", "BMI",
                  "tc.case", "fu", "region_code", "region_is_urban")]      
total3 <- total3 %>%
  mutate(age.ca=ifelse(age_at_study >=30 & age_at_study <40,1,
                       ifelse(age_at_study >=40& age_at_study <50,2,
                              ifelse(age_at_study >=50 & age_at_study <60,3,
                                     ifelse(age_at_study >=60 & age_at_study <70 ,4,5)))))
total3 <- total3 %>%
  mutate(education = education + 1,
         occupation = occupation + 1,
         household_income = household_income + 1) %>%
  mutate(sep_score = education + occupation + household_income) %>%
  mutate(sep_score_cat = ifelse(sep_score <= 5, 1,
                                 ifelse(sep_score == 6, 2, 3)))

# 20260119 Add alcohol comsumption and exercise
total3 <- left_join(
  total3,
  questionnaires[,c("csid", "alcohol_category", "met")],
  by="csid"
)
table(total3$alcohol_category)

total3 <- total3 %>%
  mutate(
    alcohol.cat = ifelse(alcohol_category %in% c(1), 0,
                         ifelse(alcohol_category %in% c(2), 1, 2))
  ) %>%
  group_by(is_female) %>%
  mutate(
    met.cat = ifelse(met < quantile(met, 0.75), 0, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
table(total3$met.cat)

table(total3$cancer_diag) # 2538 cases

# Exclude those with cancer diagnosis at baseline
total3 <- total3 %>%
  subset(cancer_diag == 0)
```

# SEP Construction and LCA

```{r lca-analysis}
# LCA analysis
# Define the number of classes
set.seed(2025)
f2 <- cbind(education,occupation,household_income)~1
sep_1 <- poLCA(f2, total3, nclass = 2) # AIC 2366694  -
sep_2 <- poLCA(f2, total3, nclass = 3) # AIC 2347835 0.7%
sep_3 <- poLCA(f2, total3, nclass = 4) # AIC 2346718 0.05%
sep_4 <- poLCA(f2, total3, nclass = 5) # AIC 2346477 0.01%

table(sep_2$predclass,total3$sep_score_cat)

lcmodel <- reshape2::melt(sep_2$probs, level=3)
lcmodel <- lcmodel %>%
  mutate(Var1 = case_when(grepl("1",Var1) ~ "Medium SEP",
                          grepl("2",Var1) ~ "High SEP",
                          grepl("3",Var1) ~ "Low SEP")) %>%
  mutate(Var2 = case_when(grepl("1",Var2) ~ "Low",
                          grepl("2",Var2) ~ "Medium",
                          grepl("3",Var2) ~ "High"))

zp1 <- ggplot(lcmodel,aes(x = L3, y = value, fill = factor(Var2, levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High")))) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', position = 'stack', width = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(factor(Var1, levels = c("Low SEP", "Medium SEP", "High SEP"))~.) +
  scale_fill_brewer(type = 'seq', palette = 'Greens') +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = '', fill = 'probabilities') +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) 
zp2 <- zp1 +
  theme(
    # Axis text (tick labels)
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    
    # Axis titles
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 10)),
    
    # Facet labels
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    
    # Legend text
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )

ggsave(zp2, filename = "lca_sep_classification.png", width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)

sep_lca_predclass <- sep_2$predclass
total3$sep_lca_cat <- dplyr::case_when(
  sep_lca_predclass == 1 ~ 2,
  sep_lca_predclass == 2 ~ 3,
  sep_lca_predclass == 3 ~ 1,
  TRUE ~ NA_real_
)

table(total3$sep_lca_cat, total3$sep_score_cat)

# set factor cov
factor_cov <- c("age.ca", "is_female", "region_is_urban",
                "BMI.cat", "fam.ca", "smoking_category",
                "alcohol.cat", "met.cat",
                "education", "occupation", "household_income",
                "sep_score_cat", "sep_lca_cat")

# Change to factor
total3 <- total3 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(factor_cov), as.factor))
```

```{r baseline-characteristics}
pvalue <- function(x, ...) {
    # Construct vectors of data y, and groups (strata) g
    y <- unlist(x)
    g <- factor(rep(1:length(x), times=sapply(x, length)))
    if (is.numeric(y)) {
        # For numeric variables, perform a standard 2-sample t-test
        q <- summary(aov(y ~ g))
        p <- q[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1] 
    } else {
        # For categorical variables, perform a chi-squared test of independence
        p <- chisq.test(table(y, g))$p.value
    }
    # Format the p-value, using an HTML entity for the less-than sign.
    # The initial empty string places the output on the line below the variable label.
    c("", sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits=3, eps=0.001)))
}
```

# Main Cox Models

```{r main-cox-models}
# SEP assessed by assigning points ####
# Crude_model
sep_score_cruel <- coxph(Surv(fu, tc.case) ~ sep_score_cat, data = total3)

# Model 1
sep_score_m1 <- coxph(Surv(fu, tc.case) ~ sep_score_cat + strata(age.ca) +
                      is_female, data = total3)

# Model 2
sep_score_m2 <- coxph(Surv(fu, tc.case) ~ sep_score_cat + strata(age.ca) +
                      is_female + region_is_urban + smoking_category +
                      BMI.cat + fam.ca + marital_status, data = total3)
cox.zph(sep_score_m2)

# Model 3  (use to sensitivity analysis)
sep_score_m3 <- coxme(Surv(fu, tc.case) ~ sep_score_cat + strata(age.ca) +
                      is_female +  smoking_category + region_is_urban +
                      BMI.cat + fam.ca + marital_status +
                      (1 | region_code), data = total3)

# Model 4 [overlooked]  (use to sensitivity analysis)
sep_score_m4 <- coxph(Surv(fu, tc.case) ~ sep_score_cat + age_at_study +
                      is_female + smoking_category + region_is_urban +
                      BMI.cat + fam.ca + marital_status +
                      tt(age_at_study), data = total3,
                      tt = function(x, t, ...) x*t)
                      
# Model 5  (use to sensitivity analysis)
sep_score_m5 <- coxph(Surv(fu, tc.case) ~ sep_score_cat + ns(age_at_study, df = 4) +
                      is_female + smoking_category + region_is_urban +
                      BMI.cat + fam.ca + marital_status + alcohol.cat,
                      data = total3)

# Model 6 added alcohol consumption
sep_score_m6 <- coxph(Surv(fu, tc.case) ~ sep_score_cat + strata(age.ca) +
                      is_female + region_is_urban + smoking_category +
                      BMI.cat + fam.ca + marital_status + alcohol.cat,
                      data = total3)
cox.zph(sep_score_m6)

extract_rf <- function(x, col_name) {
  # x may be a list (e.g., $region_code) or a named vector/matrix
  if (is.list(x)) {
    v <- if ("region_code" %in% names(x)) x[["region_code"]] else x[[1]]
  } else {
    v <- x
  }
  if (is.matrix(v) || is.data.frame(v)) v <- v[, 1]
  out <- data.frame(region_code = names(v), tmp = as.numeric(v), row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE)
  names(out)[2] <- col_name
  out
}

rf_df_list <- purrr::imap(rf, extract_rf)
rf_combined <- purrr::reduce(rf_df_list, dplyr::full_join, by = "region_code") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(region_code))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(-region_code, ~ round(., 2)))
print(rf_combined)

write.csv(rf_combined, "random_effects_by_region.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Modified function to handle coxme objects differently
extract_formatted_hr_ci <- function(model, model_name) {
  # Different handling based on model class
  if (inherits(model, "coxme")) {
    # Manual extraction for coxme models
    coef_vals <- coef(model)
    var_vals <- diag(vcov(model))
    
    # Create a dataframe with necessary information
    model_results <- data.frame(
      term = names(coef_vals),
      estimate = exp(coef_vals),
      conf.low = exp(coef_vals - 1.96 * sqrt(var_vals)),
      conf.high = exp(coef_vals + 1.96 * sqrt(var_vals)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    # For regular coxph models
    model_results <- broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Filter for sep_score_cat terms and format results
  model_results <- model_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl("sep_|educa|occu|inco", term)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      level = gsub("sep_", "", term) %>% trimws(),
      formatted = sprintf("HR: %.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
      model_name = model_name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(model_name, level, formatted)
  
  return(model_results)
}

combine_cox_results <- function(models_list, extraction_fun) {
  # Apply the extraction function to all models and combine results
  score_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(names(models_list), function(name) {
      tryCatch({
        extraction_fun(models_list[[name]], name)
      }, error = function(e) {
        message("Error processing model: ", name, " - ", e$message)
        return(NULL)
      })
    })
  )
  
  # Create a wide format dataframe with models as rows and levels as columns
  score_results <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    score_results,
    id_cols = model_name,
    names_from = level,
    values_from = formatted
  ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Model = model_name) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(low = "Reference")
  
  # Reorder columns: Model, low, other levels
  cols_order <- c("Model", "low")
  other_cols <- setdiff(names(score_results), cols_order)
  score_results <- score_results[, c(cols_order, other_cols)]
  
  return(score_results)
}

  "Model 1" = sep_score_m1,
```

```{r age-incidence-plots}
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Poisson exact CI on rate per PY
    .pp = list(poisson.test(disease_cases, T = person_year, conf.level = 0.95)$conf.int),
    rate_per_1e5 = (disease_cases / person_year) * 1e5,
    ci_low_per_1e5 = .pp[[1]][1] * 1e5,
    ci_high_per_1e5 = .pp[[2]][1] * 1e5
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(age_group, person_year, disease_cases,
         incidence_rate = rate_per_1e5,
         ci_low = ci_low_per_1e5, ci_high = ci_high_per_1e5)

age_rate_calculator <- function(data, event, time,
                            strata = NULL, age_strata = NULL,
                            unit = 100000, add_ci = FALSE, conf.level = 0.95) {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(data))
  stopifnot(is.character(event), event %in% names(data))
  stopifnot(is.character(time), time %in% names(data))
  if (!is.null(strata)) stopifnot(is.character(strata), strata %in% names(data))
  if (!is.null(age_strata)) stopifnot(is.character(age_strata), age_strata %in% names(data))

  df <- data %>%
    mutate(`..event` = as.numeric(.data[[event]]),
           `..time`  = as.numeric(.data[[time]]))

  # No grouping
  if (is.null(strata) && is.null(age_strata)) {
    total_py <- sum(df$`..time`, na.rm = TRUE)
    k <- sum(df$`..event`, na.rm = TRUE)
    out <- data.frame(
      count = k,
      person_years = total_py,
      rate = ifelse(total_py > 0, k / total_py * unit, NA_real_)
    )
    if (add_ci) {
      ci <- if (total_py > 0) poisson.test(k, T = total_py, conf.level = conf.level)$conf.int else c(NA_real_, NA_real_)
      out$ci_low <- ci[1] * unit
      out$ci_high <- ci[2] * unit
    }
    return(out)
  }

  # One grouping
  if (!is.null(strata) && is.null(age_strata)) {
    g1 <- rlang::sym(strata)
    out <- df %>%
      group_by(!!g1, .drop = FALSE) %>%
      summarise(
        person_years = sum(`..time`, na.rm = TRUE),
        count = sum(`..event`, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        rate = ifelse(person_years > 0, count / person_years * unit, NA_real_)
      )
    if (add_ci) {
      out <- out %>%
        rowwise() %>%
        mutate(
          .ci = list(if (person_years > 0) poisson.test(count, T = person_years, conf.level = conf.level)$conf.int else c(NA_real_, NA_real_)),
          ci_low = .ci[[1]] * unit,
          ci_high = .ci[[2]] * unit
        ) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        dplyr::select(-.ci)
    }
    names(out)[1] <- strata
    return(out)
  }

  # Two groupings: SEP within age groups (or vice versa)
  g1 <- rlang::sym(strata)
  g2 <- rlang::sym(age_strata)
  out <- df %>%
    group_by(!!g1, !!g2, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    summarise(
      person_years = sum(`..time`, na.rm = TRUE),
      count = sum(`..event`, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::complete(!!g1, !!g2, fill = list(person_years = 0, count = 0)) %>%
    mutate(
      rate = ifelse(person_years > 0, count / person_years * unit, NA_real_)
    )

  if (add_ci) {
    out <- out %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        .ci = list(if (person_years > 0) poisson.test(count, T = person_years, conf.level = conf.level)$conf.int else c(NA_real_, NA_real_)),
        ci_low = .ci[[1]] * unit,
        ci_high = .ci[[2]] * unit
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::select(-.ci)
  }

  names(out)[1:2] <- c(strata, age_strata)
  out
}
```

# Multiplicative Interaction: Age

```{r interaction-age}
total3$sep_score_bin <- ifelse(total3$sep_score_cat == 3, 1, 0)
total3$sep_lca_bin <- ifelse(total3$sep_lca_cat == 3, 1, 0)
total3$education_bin <- ifelse(total3$education == 3, 1, 0)
total3$occupation_bin <- ifelse(total3$occupation == 3, 1, 0)
total3$income_bin <- ifelse(total3$household_income == 3, 1, 0)


# Age (50) ####
total3$age_bin <- cut(total3$age_at_study, breaks = c(-Inf, 50, Inf), labels = c("<50", ">=50"), right = FALSE)
total3$age_bin <- factor(total3$age_bin, levels = c(">=50", "<50"))
# score
age_50less_score <- coxph(Surv(fu, tc.case) ~ sep_score_bin +
                is_female + region_is_urban + smoking_category +
                BMI.cat + fam.ca + marital_status,
                data = total3[total3$age_bin == "<50",])
age_50more_score <- coxph(Surv(fu, tc.case) ~ sep_score_bin +
                is_female + region_is_urban + smoking_category +
                BMI.cat + fam.ca + marital_status,
                data = total3[total3$age_bin == ">=50",])
age_interaction_score <- coxph(Surv(fu, tc.case) ~
                sep_score_bin:age_bin +
                sep_score_bin + age_bin +
                is_female + region_is_urban + smoking_category +
                BMI.cat + fam.ca + marital_status,
                data = total3)


age_m3_score <- coxph(Surv(fu, tc.case) ~ 
                sep_score_bin + age_bin +
                is_female + region_is_urban + smoking_category +
                BMI.cat + fam.ca + marital_status,
                data = total3)
anova(age_interaction_score, age_m3_score)
models_age_list <- list(
  "Age <50" = age_50less_score,
  "Age >=50" = age_50more_score
)
age_score_results <- combine_cox_results(models_age_list, extract_formatted_hr_ci)
age_score_results[1,4] <- anova(age_interaction_score, age_m3_score)$'Pr(>|Chi|)'[2]
print(age_score_results)

# lca

                is_female + region_is_urban + smoking_category +
                BMI.cat + fam.ca + marital_status,
                data = total3[total3$age_bin == "<50",])
age_50more_lca <- coxph(Surv(fu, tc.case) ~ sep_lca_bin +
                is_female + region_is_urban + smoking_category +
                BMI.cat + fam.ca + marital_status,
                data = total3[total3$age_bin == ">=50",])
age_interaction_lca <- coxph(Surv(fu, tc.case) ~
                sep_lca_bin * age_bin +
                sep_lca_bin + age_bin +
                is_female + region_is_urban + smoking_category +
                BMI.cat + fam.ca + marital_status,
                data = total3)


age_m3_lca <- coxph(Surv(fu, tc.case) ~ 
                sep_lca_bin + age_bin +
```

# Subgroup Forest Plots

```{r subgroup-forest-plots}
extract_hr_values <- function(hr_string) {
  hr_string <- as.character(hr_string)
  if (length(hr_string) == 0 || is.na(hr_string) || !str_detect(hr_string, "\\d+\\.\\d+")) {
    return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_))
  }

  estimate <- as.numeric(str_extract(hr_string, "\\d+\\.\\d+"))
  lower_ci <- as.numeric(str_extract(hr_string, "(?<=\\()\\d+\\.\\d+"))
  upper_ci <- as.numeric(str_extract(hr_string, "(?<=-)\\d+\\.\\d+"))
  c(estimate, lower_ci, upper_ci)
}

prepare_subgroup_forest_data <- function(data) {
  medium_values <- t(vapply(data$`medium HR (95% CI)`, extract_hr_values, numeric(3)))
  high_values <- t(vapply(data$`high HR (95% CI)`, extract_hr_values, numeric(3)))

  data %>%
    mutate(
      medium_estimate = medium_values[, 1],
      medium_lower_ci = medium_values[, 2],
      medium_upper_ci = medium_values[, 3],
      high_estimate = high_values[, 1],
      high_lower_ci = high_values[, 2],
      high_upper_ci = high_values[, 3],
      ` ` = paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " "),
      `  ` = paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " "),
      `P-value` = ifelse(is.na(`P-value`), "", as.character(round(as.numeric(`P-value`), 3)))
    )
}

plot_subgroup_forest <- function(forest_data, filename) {
  tm <- forest_theme(
    base_size = 10,
    refline_col = "black",
    footnote_gp = gpar(col = "blue"),
    ci_col = c("#f55858ff"),
    core = list(bg_params = list(fill = c("#ffffffff")))
  )

  subgroup_forest <- forest(
    forest_data[, c(
      "Variables", "Model", "Low", "medium HR (95% CI)",
      " ", "high HR (95% CI)", "  ", "P-value"
    )],
    est = list(forest_data$medium_estimate, forest_data$high_estimate),
    lower = list(forest_data$medium_lower_ci, forest_data$high_lower_ci),
    upper = list(forest_data$medium_upper_ci, forest_data$high_upper_ci),
    ci_column = c(5, 7),
    ref_line = 1,
    xlim = c(0, 6),
    ticks_at = c(0, 1, 2, 4, 6),
    xlab = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)",
    theme = tm
  )

  subgroup_forest <- add_border(subgroup_forest, part = "header")
  ggsave(subgroup_forest, filename = filename, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  subgroup_forest
}

prepare_age_forest_data <- function(data) {
  hr_cols <- c(
    "score_bin",
    "lca_bin",
    "education_bin",
    "income_bin",
    "occupation_bin"
  )
  p_cols <- names(data)[c(4, 6, 8, 10, 12)]

  hr_values <- lapply(
    hr_cols,
    function(col_name) t(vapply(data[[col_name]], extract_hr_values, numeric(3)))
  )
  names(hr_values) <- hr_cols

  display_data <- data.frame(
    Model = data$Model,
    `Score-based method` = data$score_bin,
    ` ` = paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " "),
    `P score` = ifelse(is.na(data[[p_cols[1]]]), "", round(as.numeric(data[[p_cols[1]]]), 3)),
    `LCA-based method` = data$lca_bin,
    `  ` = paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " "),
    `P LCA` = ifelse(is.na(data[[p_cols[2]]]), "", round(as.numeric(data[[p_cols[2]]]), 3)),
    Education = data$education_bin,
    `   ` = paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " "),
    `P education` = ifelse(is.na(data[[p_cols[3]]]), "", round(as.numeric(data[[p_cols[3]]]), 3)),
    `Household income` = data$income_bin,
    `    ` = paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " "),
    `P income` = ifelse(is.na(data[[p_cols[4]]]), "", round(as.numeric(data[[p_cols[4]]]), 3)),
    `Occupation prestige` = data$occupation_bin,
    `     ` = paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " "),
    `P occupation` = ifelse(is.na(data[[p_cols[5]]]), "", round(as.numeric(data[[p_cols[5]]]), 3)),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  attr(display_data, "hr_values") <- hr_values
  display_data
}

plot_age_forest <- function(forest_data, filename) {
  hr_values <- attr(forest_data, "hr_values")
  tm <- forest_theme(
    base_size = 10,
    refline_col = "black",
    footnote_gp = gpar(col = "blue"),
    ci_col = c("#000000")
  )

  age_forest <- forest(
    forest_data,
    est = lapply(hr_values, function(x) x[, 1]),
    lower = lapply(hr_values, function(x) x[, 2]),
    upper = lapply(hr_values, function(x) x[, 3]),
    ci_column = c(3, 6, 9, 12, 15),
    ref_line = 1,
    xlim = c(0, 4),
    ticks_at = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4),
    xlab = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)",
    theme = tm
  )

  age_forest <- add_border(age_forest, part = "header")
  ggsave(age_forest, filename = filename, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  age_forest
}

age_forest_data <- prepare_age_forest_data(age_subgroup_results)
age_forest <- plot_age_forest(age_forest_data, "age_subgroup_forest.pdf")

sex_forest_data <- prepare_subgroup_forest_data(sex_subgroup_results)
sex_forest <- plot_subgroup_forest(sex_forest_data, "sex_subgroup_forest.pdf")

BMI_forest_data <- prepare_subgroup_forest_data(BMI_subgroup)
BMI_forest <- plot_subgroup_forest(BMI_forest_data, "bmi_subgroup_forest.pdf")
```

# Regional ASIR, ASMR, and GDP

```{r regional-asdr}
# Calculate ASDR for each region ####
total2 <- total2 %>% 
  mutate(age_endpoint=age_at_study+round(fu,2)) %>%
  mutate(age.ca3=ifelse(age_endpoint<50,1,
                        ifelse(age_endpoint<70,2,3)))
total2$age.ca3 <- as.factor(total2$age.ca3)
total_12 <- total2[total2$cancer_diag == 0,] %>% subset(region_code %in% c(12))
total_16 <- total2[total2$cancer_diag == 0,] %>% subset(region_code %in% c(16))
total_26 <- total2[total2$cancer_diag == 0,] %>% subset(region_code %in% c(26))
total_36 <- total2[total2$cancer_diag == 0,] %>% subset(region_code %in% c(36))
total_46 <- total2[total2$cancer_diag == 0,] %>% subset(region_code %in% c(46))
total_52 <- total2[total2$cancer_diag == 0,] %>% subset(region_code %in% c(52))
total_58 <- total2[total2$cancer_diag == 0,] %>% subset(region_code %in% c(58))
total_68 <- total2[total2$cancer_diag == 0,] %>% subset(region_code %in% c(68))
total_78 <- total2[total2$cancer_diag == 0,] %>% subset(region_code %in% c(78))
total_88 <- total2[total2$cancer_diag == 0,] %>% subset(region_code %in% c(88))
result <- data.frame(
  region = character(),
  age_group = integer(),
  person_year = numeric(),
  disease_cases = integer(),
  incidence_rate = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Define regions code
regions <- c(12, 16, 26, 36, 46, 52, 58, 68, 78, 88)

# Iterate through each region and calculate person-year and crude incidence rate
for (region in regions) {
  
  df_name <- paste0("total_", region)
  df <- get(df_name)
  
  # Calculate person-year and incidence rate for the current region for each age group
  summary_df <- df %>%
    group_by(age.ca3) %>%
    summarise(
      person_year = sum(fu.death),                 
      disease_cases = sum(ep_range_C73_to__odu_ep),                 
      incidence_rate = (disease_cases / person_year) * 100000  
    ) %>%
    mutate(region = region)  
  result <- rbind(result, summary_df)
}

# Load standard population data
sp <- read.csv("SP.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
result <- cbind(sp,result)
# Calculate ASIR
asir_result <- result %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(
    total_sp = sum(SP),  # 计算总人口数
    ASIR = sum((incidence_rate * (SP / total_sp)))  # 计算ASR
  )

print(asir_result)
write.csv(asir_result,
          "asdr_result.csv",
          row.names=F)
```

```{r regional-map-and-correlation-plots}
plot_asir <- ggplot(region_data, aes(x = aGDP_per_capita, y = ASIR)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = area), alpha = 0.7, size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Urban" = "#3f34e5ff", "Rural" = "#08eb7dff")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(min(region_data$aGDP_per_capita), max(region_data$aGDP_per_capita)), ylim = c(0, 40)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "ASIR per 100,000 Person-year", n.breaks = 5) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Average GDP per capita during 2005-2016", n.breaks = 5, labels = comma) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#fefefeff"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(label = region_data$de_name, size = 4, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  labs(color = "Area", title = "Correlation between GDP per capita and ASIR") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = min(region_data$aGDP_per_capita) + 0.1,
    y = 35,
    label = "Spearman correlation: \n r = 0.66 \n p = 0.038",
    hjust = 0,
    size = 6,
    fontface = "italic"
  )

plot_asmr <- ggplot(region_data, aes(x = aGDP_per_capita, y = ASDR)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = area), alpha = 0.7, size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Urban" = "#3f34e5ff", "Rural" = "#08eb7dff")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(min(region_data$aGDP_per_capita), max(region_data$aGDP_per_capita)), ylim = c(0, 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "ASMR per 100,000 Person-year", n.breaks = 5) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Average GDP per capita during 2005-2016", n.breaks = 5, labels = comma) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#fefefeff"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold")
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(label = region_data$de_name, size = 4, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  labs(color = "Area", title = "Correlation between GDP per capita and ASMR") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = min(region_data$aGDP_per_capita) + 0.1,
    y = 1.75,
    label = "Spearman correlation: \n r = 0.47 \n p = 0.17",
    hjust = 0,
    size = 6,
    fontface = "italic"
  )

combined_plots <- plot_asir | plot_asmr
ggsave(
  "combined_plots.pdf",
  plot = combined_plots,
  width = 18,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)
```
